_documentation.model_purpose: Pure Quantitative Wave Multiscale Tree (W x σVc x σc x vel) across 712 tickers
_documentation.return_formula: Real Return = (Price(t_pivot_next) / Close(t)) - 1. Zero Ghost Return bias.
_documentation.horizon_gate: Maximum horizon = 120 days. Captures wave cycles to next ZigZag pivot (2.5%, 5.0%, 7.5%).

state_hierarchy.L3: Wave Direction State: W_slope (6 macro wave slope states)
state_hierarchy.L2: Mid-Micro State: W_slope|σVc (30 mid-wave cycle states)
state_hierarchy.L1: Full 4D State: W_slope|σVc|σc|vel_σVw (450 granular micro timing states)

vwap_sigma_wave_position.<<: FLOOR — Price far below VWAP Wave (sigma_vwap < -1.0 std dev)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.<: BELOW — Price moderately below VWAP Wave (-1.0 <= sigma_vwap < -0.30)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.~: NEUTRAL — Price near VWAP Wave center (-0.30 <= sigma_vwap <= +0.30)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.>: ABOVE — Price moderately above VWAP Wave (+0.30 < sigma_vwap <= +1.0)
vwap_sigma_wave_position.>>: CEILING — Price far above VWAP Wave (sigma_vwap > +1.0 std dev)

velocity.\u25b2: Upward velocity in price/VWAP deviation (rising relative momentum)
velocity.\u25bc: Downward velocity in price/VWAP deviation (falling relative momentum)

field_glossary.n: Sample size for this state/level combination
field_glossary.p_bull: P(next pivot = MAX). Probability of upward swing completion
field_glossary.p_bear: P(next pivot = MIN). Probability of downward swing completion
field_glossary.ev_net: Net Expected Value: P(bull)*E[ret_max] + P(bear)*E[ret_min] minus 10bps friction
field_glossary.e_ret_min: Expected real drawdown % to next MIN pivot
field_glossary.e_ret_max: Expected real upside gain % to next MAX pivot
field_glossary.avg_days_to_max: Average calendar days to reach MAX pivot
field_glossary.avg_days_to_min: Average calendar days to reach MIN pivot

_documentation.signal_interpretation_policy: Clean Architecture Standard: Tactical actions are dynamically evaluated in runtime by pure-domain Wave classifiers (rc_wave_multiscale_lookup.py) using empirical P(bull), EV, and R:R asymmetry.
